content:wysiwyg_basic:4:36.html:
About Us

The purpose of the Women’s Auxiliary is to assist The Salvation Army Metro Atlanta Area Command in all its activities in the community and to provide volunteer workers for the many projects connected with its religious and humanitarian endeavors.

The Women’s Auxiliary provides an opportunity for women to meet in a spiritual atmosphere, enjoy programs and relationships, and contribute skills and resources to better our community and the world around us.

General Meetings

The Auxiliary meetings are held the third Thursday of each month at 10:00 a.m., September through May. Meeting locations are announced for each monthly meeting and feature refreshments and special guest speakers.

Annual membership dues: $40.00

Contact: Major Stacie McWilliams
stacie.mcwilliams@uss.salvationarmy.org
